# iOS App Icons

iOS requires a single 1024x1024 icon, which Xcode will resize automatically.

## Icon Requirements

### App Store Icon
- Size: 1024x1024 pixels
- Format: PNG (no alpha/transparency)
- File: `AppIcon.png`

### Device Icons (Auto-generated by Xcode)
| Device | Size |
|--------|------|
| iPhone | 60x60 @2x, @3x |
| iPad | 76x76 @1x, @2x |
| iPad Pro | 83.5x83.5 @2x |
| Settings | 29x29 @1x, @2x, @3x |
| Spotlight | 40x40 @1x, @2x, @3x |
| Notifications | 20x20 @1x, @2x, @3x |

## After Running `npx cap add ios`

1. Open `ios/App/App.xcworkspace` in Xcode
2. Navigate to `App > Assets.xcassets > AppIcon`
3. Drag your 1024x1024 icon to the "App Store iOS 1024pt" slot
4. Use "Single Size" option to auto-generate all sizes

Or use Capacitor Assets plugin:
```bash
npm install -g @capacitor/assets
npx capacitor-assets generate --ios
```

## Design Guidelines

- No transparency (must have solid background)
- No rounded corners (iOS adds automatically)
- Design for both light and dark modes
- MegaMart: Orange background (#f97316) with white "M" logo

## Recommended Tools

1. **App Icon Generator**: https://appicon.co/
2. **MakeAppIcon**: https://makeappicon.com/
3. **Xcode**: Built-in asset catalog editor
